1.zh: 耶稣基督的启示，就是　神赐给他，叫他将必要快成的事指示他的众仆人。他就差遣使者晓谕他的仆人约翰。
1.en: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,

1.zh: 约翰便将　神的道和耶稣基督的见证，凡自己所看见的都证明出来。
1.en: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

1.zh: 念这书上预言的和那些听见又遵守其中所记载的，都是有福的，因为日期近了。
1.en: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

1.zh: 约翰写信给亚细亚的七个教会。但愿从那昔在、今在、以后永在的　[神]，和他宝座前的七灵，
1.en: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

1.zh: 并那诚实作见证的、从死里首先复活、为世上君王元首的耶稣基督，有恩惠、平安归与你们！ 他爱我们，用自己的血使我们脱离罪恶，
1.en: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—

1.zh: 又使我们成为国民，作他父　神的祭司。但愿荣耀、权能归给他，直到永永远远。阿们！
1.en: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

1.zh: 看哪，他驾云降临！ 众目要看见他， 连刺他的人也要看见他； 地上的万族都要因他哀哭。 这话是真实的。阿们！
1.en: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

1.zh: 主　神说：「我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛，是昔在、今在、以后[永]在的全能者。」
1.en: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

1.zh: 我—约翰就是你们的弟兄，和你们在耶稣的患难、国度、忍耐里一同有分，为　神的道，并为给耶稣作的见证，曾在那名叫拔摩的海岛上。
1.en: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 当主日，我被[圣]灵感动，听见在我后面有大声音如吹号，说：
1.en: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

1.zh: 「你所看见的当写在书上，达与以弗所、士每拿、别迦摩、推雅推喇、撒狄、非拉铁非、老底嘉那七个教会。」
1.en: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”

1.zh: 我转过身来，要看是谁发声与我说话；既转过来，就看见七个金灯台。
1.en: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.

1.zh: 灯台中间有一位好像人子，身穿长衣，直垂到脚，胸间束着金带。
1.en: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

1.zh: 他的头与发皆白，如白羊毛，如雪；眼目如同火焰；
1.en: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

1.zh: 脚好像在炉中锻炼光明的铜；声音如同众水的声音。
1.en: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.

1.zh: 他右手拿着七星，从他口中出来一把两刃的利剑；面貌如同烈日放光。
1.en: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

1.zh: 我一看见，就仆倒在他脚前，像死了一样。他用右手按着我，说：「不要惧怕！我是首先的，我是末后的，
1.en: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,

1.zh: 又是那存活的；我曾死过，现在又活了，直活到永永远远；并且拿着死亡和阴间的钥匙。
1.en: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.

1.zh: 所以你要把所看见的，和现在的事，并将来必成的事，都写出来。
1.en: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.

1.zh: 论到你所看见、在我右手中的七星和七个金灯台的奥秘，那七星就是七个教会的使者，七灯台就是七个教会。」
1.en: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamp stands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.

2.zh: 「你要写信给以弗所教会的使者，说：『那右手拿着七星、在七个金灯台中间行走的，说：
2.en: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:

2.zh: 我知道你的行为、劳碌、忍耐，也知道你不能容忍恶人。你也曾试验那自称为使徒却不是使徒的，看出他们是假的来。
2.en: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

2.zh: 你也能忍耐，曾为我的名劳苦，并不乏倦。
2.en: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.

2.zh: 然而有一件事我要责备你，就是你把起初的爱心离弃了。
2.en: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.

2.zh: 所以，应当回想你是从哪里坠落的，并要悔改，行起初所行的事。你若不悔改，我就临到你那里，把你的灯台从原处挪去。
2.en: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.

2.zh: 然而你还有一件可取的事，就是你恨恶尼哥拉一党人的行为，这也是我所恨恶的。
2.en: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

2.zh: [圣]灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！得胜的，我必将　神乐园中生命树的果子赐给他吃。』」
2.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.

2.zh: 「你要写信给士每拿教会的使者，说：『那首先的、末后的、死过又活的，说：
2.en: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:

2.zh: 我知道你的患难，你的贫穷（你却是富足的），也知道那自称是犹太人所说的毁谤话，其实他们不是犹太人，乃是撒但一会的人。
2.en: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

2.zh: 你将要受的苦你不用怕。魔鬼要把你们中间几个人下在监里，叫你们被试炼，你们必受患难十日。你务要至死忠心，我就赐给你那生命的冠冕。
2.en: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.

2.zh: [圣]灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！得胜的，必不受第二次死的害。』」
2.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.

2.zh: 「你要写信给别迦摩教会的使者，说：『那有两刃利剑的，说：
2.en: “To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:

2.zh: 我知道你的居所，就是有撒但座位之处；当我忠心的见证人安提帕在你们中间、撒但所住的地方被杀之时，你还坚守我的名，没有弃绝我的道。
2.en: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

2.zh: 然而，有几件事我要责备你：因为在你那里有人服从了巴兰的教训；这巴兰曾教导巴勒将绊脚石放在以色列人面前，叫他们吃祭偶像之物，行奸淫的事。
2.en: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.

2.zh: 你那里也有人照样服从了尼哥拉一党人的教训。
2.en: So also you likewise have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

2.zh: 所以，你当悔改；若不悔改，我就快临到你那里，用我口中的剑攻击他们。
2.en: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

2.zh: [圣]灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！得胜的，我必将那隐藏的吗哪赐给他，并赐他一块白石，石上写着新名；除了那领受的以外，没有人能认识。』」
2.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.

2.zh: 「你要写信给推雅推喇教会的使者，说：『那眼目如火焰、脚像光明铜的　神之子说：
2.en: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:

2.zh: 我知道你的行为、爱心、信心、勤劳、忍耐，又知道你末后所行的[善]事，比起初所行的更多。
2.en: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.

2.zh: 然而，有一件事我要责备你，就是你容让那自称是先知的妇人耶洗别教导我的仆人，引诱他们行奸淫，吃祭偶像之物。
2.en: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

2.zh: 我曾给她悔改的机会，她却不肯悔改她的淫行。
2.en: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.

2.zh: 看哪，我要叫她病卧在床。那些与她行淫的人，若不悔改所行的，我也要叫他们同受大患难。
2.en: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.

2.zh: 我又要杀死她的党类，叫众教会知道，我是那察看人肺腑心肠的，并要照你们的行为报应你们各人。
2.en: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

2.zh: 至于你们推雅推喇其余的人，就是一切不从那教训、不晓得他们素常所说撒但深奥之理的人，我告诉你们，我不将别的担子放在你们身上。
2.en: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira—as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan’—to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.

2.zh: 但你们已经有的，总要持守，直等到我来。
2.en: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.

2.zh: 那得胜又遵守我命令到底的，我要赐给他权柄制伏列国；
2.en: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.

2.zh: 他必用铁杖辖管他们，将他们如同窑户的瓦器打得粉碎，像我从我父领受的权柄一样。
2.en: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots, as I also have received of my Father;

2.zh: 我又要把晨星赐给他。
2.en: and I will give him the morning star.

2.zh: [圣]灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！』」
2.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

3.zh: 「你要写信给撒狄教会的使者，说：『那有　神的七灵和七星的，说：我知道你的行为，按名你是活的，其实是死的。
3.en: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

3.zh: 你要警醒，坚固那剩下将要衰微的；因我见你的行为，在我　神面前，没有一样是完全的。
3.en: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

3.zh: 所以要回想你是怎样领受、怎样听见的，又要遵守，并要悔改。若不警醒，我必临到你那里，如同贼一样。我几时临到，你也决不能知道。
3.en: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.

3.zh: 然而在撒狄，你还有几名是未曾污秽自己衣服的，他们要穿白衣与我同行，因为他们是配得过的。
3.en: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

3.zh: 凡得胜的必这样穿白衣，我也必不从生命册上涂抹他的名；且要在我父面前，和我父众使者面前，认他的名。
3.en: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

3.zh: [圣]灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！』」
3.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

3.zh: 「你要写信给非拉铁非教会的使者，说：『那圣洁、真实、拿着大卫的钥匙、开了就没有人能关、关了就没有人能开的，说：
3.en: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:

3.zh: 我知道你的行为，你略有一点力量，也曾遵守我的道，没有弃绝我的名。看哪，我在你面前给你一个敞开的门，是无人能关的。
3.en: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.

3.zh: 那撒但一会的，自称是犹太人，其实不是犹太人，乃是说谎话的，我要使他们来，在你脚前下拜，也使他们知道我是已经爱你了。
3.en: Behold, I make some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

3.zh: 你既遵守我忍耐的道，我必在普天下人受试炼的时候，保守你免去你的试炼。
3.en: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

3.zh: 我必快来，你要持守你所有的，免得人夺去你的冠冕。
3.en: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.

3.zh: 得胜的，我要叫他在我　神殿中作柱子，他也必不再从那里出去。我又要将我　神的名和我　神城的名（这城就是从天上、从我　神那里降下来的新耶路撒冷），并我的新名，都写在他上面。
3.en: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.

3.zh: [圣]灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！』」
3.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

3.zh: 「你要写信给老底嘉教会的使者，说：『那为阿们的，为诚信真实见证的，在　神创造万物之上为元首的，说：
3.en: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation, says these things:

3.zh: 我知道你的行为，你也不冷也不热；我巴不得你或冷或热。
3.en: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

3.zh: 你既[如]温[水]，也不冷也不热，所以我必从我口中把你吐出去。
3.en: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.

3.zh: 你说：我是富足，已经发了财，一样都不缺；却不知道你是那困苦、可怜、贫穷、瞎眼、赤身的。
3.en: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;

3.zh: 我劝你向我买火炼的金子，叫你富足；又买白衣穿上，叫你赤身的羞耻不露出来；又买眼药擦你的眼睛，使你能看见。
3.en: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.

3.zh: 凡我所疼爱的，我就责备管教他；所以你要发热心，也要悔改。
3.en: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

3.zh: 看哪，我站在门外叩门，若有听见我声音就开门的，我要进到他那里去，我与他，他与我一同坐席。
3.en: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.

3.zh: 得胜的，我要赐他在我宝座上与我同坐，就如我得了胜，在我父的宝座上与他同坐一般。
3.en: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.

3.zh: [圣]灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！』」
3.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”

4.zh: 此后，我观看，见天上有门开了。我初次听见好像吹号的声音，对我说：「你上到这里来，我要将以后必成的事指示你。」
4.en: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

4.zh: 我立刻被[圣]灵感动，见有一个宝座安置在天上，又有一位坐在宝座上。
4.en: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

4.zh: 看那坐着的，好像碧玉和红宝石；又有虹围着宝座，好像绿宝石。
4.en: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

4.zh: 宝座的周围又有二十四个座位；其上坐着二十四位长老，身穿白衣，头上戴着金冠冕。
4.en: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

4.zh: 有闪电、声音、雷轰从宝座中发出；又有七盏火灯在宝座前点着；这七灯就是　神的七灵。
4.en: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

4.zh: 宝座前好像一个玻璃海，如同水晶。 宝座中和宝座周围有四个活物，前后遍体都满了眼睛。
4.en: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

4.zh: 第一个活物像狮子，第二个像牛犊，第三个脸面像人，第四个像飞鹰。
4.en: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

4.zh: 四活物各有六个翅膀，遍体内外都满了眼睛。他们昼夜不住地说： 圣哉！圣哉！圣哉！ 主　神是昔在、今在、 以后[永]在的全能者。
4.en: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

4.zh: 每逢四活物将荣耀、尊贵、感谢归给那坐在宝座上、活到永永远远者的时候，
4.en: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

4.zh: 那二十四位长老就俯伏在坐宝座的面前敬拜那活到永永远远的，又把他们的冠冕放在宝座前，说：
4.en: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

4.zh: 我们的主，我们的　神， 你是配得荣耀、尊贵、权柄的； 因为你创造了万物， 并且万物是因你的旨意被创造而有的。
4.en: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”

5.zh: 我看见坐宝座的右手中有书卷，里外都写着字，用七印封严了。
5.en: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

5.zh: 我又看见一位大力的天使大声宣传说：「有谁配展开那书卷，揭开那七印呢？」
5.en: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

5.zh: 在天上、地上、地底下，没有能展开、能观看那书卷的。
5.en: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.

5.zh: 因为没有配展开、配观看那书卷的，我就大哭。
5.en: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

5.zh: 长老中有一位对我说：「不要哭！看哪，犹大支派中的狮子，大卫的根，他已得胜，能以展开那书卷，揭开那七印。」
5.en: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

5.zh: 我又看见宝座与四活物，并长老之中有羔羊站立，像是被杀过的，有七角七眼，就是　神的七灵，奉差遣往普天下去的。
5.en: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

5.zh: 这羔羊前来，从坐宝座的右手里拿了书卷。
5.en: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

5.zh: 他既拿了书卷，四活物和二十四位长老就俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿着琴和盛满了香的金炉；这香就是众圣徒的祈祷。
5.en: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

5.zh: 他们唱新歌，说： 你配拿书卷， 配揭开七印； 因为你曾被杀， 用自己的血 从各族、各方、各民、各国中买了人来， 叫他们归于　神，
5.en: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

5.zh: 又叫他们成为国民， 作祭司归于　神， 在地上执掌王权。
5.en: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”

5.zh: 我又看见且听见，宝座与活物并长老的周围有许多天使的声音；他们的数目有千千万万，
5.en: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,

5.zh: 大声说： 曾被杀的羔羊是配得 权柄、丰富、智慧、能力、 尊贵、荣耀、颂赞的。
5.en: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

5.zh: 我又听见在天上、地上、地底下、沧海里，和天地间一切所有被造之物，都说： 但愿颂赞、尊贵、荣耀、权势 都归给坐宝座的和羔羊， 直到永永远远！
5.en: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”

5.zh: 四活物就说：「阿们！」众长老也俯伏敬拜。
5.en: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.

6.zh: 我看见羔羊揭开七印中第一印的时候，就听见四活物中的一个活物，声音如雷，说：「你来！」
6.en: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

6.zh: 我就观看，见有一匹白马；骑在马上的，拿着弓，并有冠冕赐给他。他便出来，胜了又要胜。
6.en: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.

6.zh: 揭开第二印的时候，我听见第二个活物说：「你来！」
6.en: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

6.zh: 就另有一匹马出来，是红的，有权柄给了那骑马的，可以从地上夺去太平，使人彼此相杀；又有一把大刀赐给他。
6.en: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

6.zh: 揭开第三印的时候，我听见第三个活物说：「你来！」我就观看，见有一匹黑马；骑在马上的，手里拿着天平。
6.en: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

6.zh: 我听见在四活物中似乎有声音说：「一钱银子买一升麦子，一钱银子买三升大麦；油和酒不可糟蹋。」
6.en: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

6.zh: 揭开第四印的时候，我听见第四个活物说：「你来！」
6.en: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”

6.zh: 我就观看，见有一匹灰色马；骑在马上的，名字叫作死，阴府也随着他；有权柄赐给他们，可以用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫、野兽，杀害地上四分之一的人。
6.en: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

6.zh: 揭开第五印的时候，我看见在祭坛底下，有为　神的道、并为作见证被杀之人的灵魂，
6.en: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

6.zh: 大声喊着说：「圣洁真实的主啊，你不审判住在地上的人，给我们伸流血的冤，要等到几时呢？」
6.en: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”

6.zh: 于是有白衣赐给他们各人；又有话对他们说，还要安息片时，等着一同作仆人的和他们的弟兄也像他们被杀，满足了数目。
6.en: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

6.zh: 揭开第六印的时候，我又看见地大震动，日头变黑像毛布，满月变[红]像血，
6.en: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

6.zh: 天上的星辰坠落于地，如同无花果树被大风摇动，落下未熟的果子一样。
6.en: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

6.zh: 天就挪移，好像书卷被卷起来；山岭海岛都被挪移离开本位。
6.en: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.

6.zh: 地上的君王、臣宰、将军、富户、壮士，和一切为奴的、自主的，都藏在山洞和岩石穴里，
6.en: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

6.zh: 向山和岩石说：「倒在我们身上吧！把我们藏起来，躲避坐宝座者的面目和羔羊的忿怒；
6.en: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

6.zh: 因为他们忿怒的大日到了，谁能站得住呢？」
6.en: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

7.zh: 此后，我看见四位天使站在地的四角，执掌地上四方的风，叫风不吹在地上、海上，和树上。
7.en: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

7.zh: 我又看见另有一位天使，从日出之地上来，拿着永生　神的印。他就向那得着权柄能伤害地和海的四位天使大声喊着说：
7.en: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

7.zh: 「地与海并树木，你们不可伤害，等我们印了我们　神众仆人的额。」
7.en: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

7.zh: 我听见以色列人各支派中受印的数目有十四万四千。
7.en: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

7.zh: 犹大支派中受印的有一万二千；吕便支派中有一万二千；迦得支派中有一万二千；
7.en: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

7.zh: 亚设支派中有一万二千；拿弗他利支派中有一万二千；玛拿西支派中有一万二千；
7.en: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

7.zh: 西缅支派中有一万二千；利未支派中有一万二千；以萨迦支派中有一万二千；
7.en: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

7.zh: 西布伦支派中有一万二千；约瑟支派中有一万二千；便雅悯支派中受印的有一万二千。
7.en: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.

7.zh: 此后，我观看，见有许多的人，没有人能数过来，是从各国、各族、各民、各方来的，站在宝座和羔羊面前，身穿白衣，手拿棕树枝，
7.en: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

7.zh: 大声喊着说：「愿救恩归与坐在宝座上我们的　神，也归与羔羊！」
7.en: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

7.zh: 众天使都站在宝座和众长老并四活物的周围，在宝座前，面伏于地，敬拜　神，
7.en: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

7.zh: 说： 阿们！颂赞、荣耀、智慧、 感谢、尊贵、权柄、大力 都归与我们的　神， 直到永永远远。阿们！
7.en: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

7.zh: 长老中有一位问我说：「这些穿白衣的是谁？是从哪里来的？」
7.en: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”

7.zh: 我对他说：「我主，你知道。」他向我说：「这些人是从大患难中出来的，曾用羔羊的血把衣裳洗白净了。
7.en: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.

7.zh: 所以，他们在　神宝座前，昼夜在他殿中事奉他。坐宝座的要用帐幕覆庇他们。
7.en: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

7.zh: 他们不再饥，不再渴；日头和炎热也必不伤害他们。
7.en: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;

7.zh: 因为宝座中的羔羊必牧养他们，领他们到生命水的泉源；　神也必擦去他们一切的眼泪。」
7.en: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

8.zh: 羔羊揭开第七印的时候，天上寂静约有二刻。
8.en: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

8.zh: 我看见那站在　神面前的七位天使，有七枝号赐给他们。
8.en: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

8.zh: 另有一位天使，拿着金香炉来，站在祭坛旁边。有许多香赐给他，要和众圣徒的祈祷一同献在宝座前的金坛上。
8.en: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

8.zh: 那香的烟和众圣徒的祈祷从天使的手中一同升到　神面前。
8.en: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

8.zh: 天使拿着香炉，盛满了坛上的火，倒在地上；随有雷轰、大声、闪电、地震。
8.en: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.

8.zh: 拿着七枝号的七位天使就预备要吹。
8.en: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

8.zh: 第一位天使吹号，就有雹子与火搀着血丢在地上；地的三分之一和树的三分之一被烧了，一切的青草也被烧了。
8.en: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

8.zh: 第二位天使吹号，就有仿佛火烧着的大山扔在海中；海的三分之一变成血，
8.en: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

8.zh: 海中的活物死了三分之一，船只也坏了三分之一。
8.en: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

8.zh: 第三位天使吹号，就有烧着的大星，好像火把从天上落下来，落在江河的三分之一和众水的泉源上。
8.en: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.

8.zh: （这星名叫「茵 」。）众水的三分之一变为茵 ，因水变苦，就死了许多人。
8.en: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

8.zh: 第四位天使吹号，日头的三分之一、月亮的三分之一、星辰的三分之一都被击打，以致日月星的三分之一黑暗了，白昼的三分之一没有光，黑夜也是这样。
8.en: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

8.zh: 我又看见一个鹰飞在空中，并听见它大声说：「三位天使要吹那其余的号。你们住在地上的民，祸哉！祸哉！祸哉！」
8.en: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”

9.zh: 第五位天使吹号，我就看见一个星从天落到地上，有无底坑的钥匙赐给它。
9.en: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

9.zh: 它开了无底坑，便有烟从坑里往上冒，好像大火炉的烟；日头和天空都因这烟昏暗了。
9.en: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

9.zh: 有蝗虫从烟中出来，飞到地上；有能力赐给它们，好像地上蝎子的能力一样，
9.en: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

9.zh: 并且吩咐它们说，不可伤害地上的草和各样青物，并一切树木，惟独要伤害额上没有　神印记的人。
9.en: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

9.zh: 但不许蝗虫害死他们，只叫他们受痛苦五个月。这痛苦就像蝎子螫人的痛苦一样。
9.en: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

9.zh: 在那些日子，人要求死，决不得死；愿意死，死却远避他们。
9.en: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

9.zh: 蝗虫的形状，好像预备出战的马一样，头上戴的好像金冠冕，脸面好像[男]人的脸面，
9.en: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

9.zh: 头发像女人的头发，牙齿像狮子的牙齿。
9.en: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

9.zh: 胸前有甲，好像铁甲。它们翅膀的声音，好像许多车马奔跑上阵的声音。
9.en: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

9.zh: 有尾巴像蝎子，[尾巴上]的毒钩能伤人五个月。
9.en: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

9.zh: 有无底坑的使者作它们的王，按着希伯来话，名叫亚巴顿，希腊话，名叫亚玻伦。
9.en: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.

9.zh: 第一样灾祸过去了，还有两样灾祸要来。
9.en: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

9.zh: 第六位天使吹号，我就听见有声音从　神面前金坛的四角出来，
9.en: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

9.zh: 吩咐那吹号的第六位天使，说：「把那捆绑在幼发拉底大河的四个使者释放了。」
9.en: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

9.zh: 那四个使者就被释放；他们原是预备好了，到某年某月某日某时，要杀人的三分之一。
9.en: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

9.zh: 马军有二万万；他们的数目我听见了。
9.en: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

9.zh: 我在异象中看见那些马和骑马的，骑马的胸前有甲如火，与紫玛瑙并硫磺。马的头好像狮子头，有火、有烟、有硫磺从马的口中出来。
9.en: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

9.zh: 口中所出来的火与烟并硫磺，这三样灾杀了人的三分之一。
9.en: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

9.zh: 这马的能力是在口里和尾巴上；因这尾巴像蛇，并且有头用以害人。
9.en: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

9.zh: 其余未曾被这些灾所杀的人仍旧不悔改自己手所做的，还是去拜鬼魔和那些不能看、不能听、不能走，金、银、铜、木、石的偶像，
9.en: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.

9.zh: 又不悔改他们那些凶杀、邪术、奸淫、偷窃的事。
9.en: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

10.zh: 我又看见另有一位大力的天使从天降下，披着云彩，头上有虹，脸面像日头，两脚像火柱。
10.en: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

10.zh: 他手里拿着小书卷，是展开的。他右脚踏海，左脚踏地，
10.en: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

10.zh: 大声呼喊，好像狮子吼叫。呼喊完了，就有七雷发声。
10.en: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

10.zh: 七雷发声之后，我正要写出来，就听见从天上有声音说：「七雷所说的，你要封上，不可写出来。」
10.en: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

10.zh: 我所看见的那踏海踏地的天使向天举起右手来，
10.en: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky

10.zh: 指着那创造天和天上之物，地和地上之物，海和海中之物，直活到永永远远的，起誓说：「不再有时日了。」
10.en: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

10.zh: 但在第七位天使吹号发声的时候，　神的奥秘就成全了，正如　神所传给他仆人众先知的佳音。
10.en: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.

10.zh: 我先前从天上所听见的那声音又吩咐我说：「你去，把那踏海踏地之天使手中展开的小书卷取过来。」
10.en: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

10.zh: 我就走到天使那里，对他说：「请你把小书卷给我。」他对我说：「你拿着吃尽了，便叫你肚子发苦，然而在你口中要甜如蜜。」
10.en: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

10.zh: 我从天使手中把小书卷接过来，吃尽了，在我口中果然甜如蜜，吃了以后，肚子觉得发苦了。
10.en: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

10.zh: 天使对我说：「你必指着多民、多国、多方、多王再说预言。」
10.en: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

11.zh: 有一根苇子赐给我，当作量度的杖；且有话说：「起来！将　神的殿和祭坛，并在殿中礼拜的人都量一量。
11.en: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

11.zh: 只是殿外的院子要留下不用量，因为这是给了外邦人的；他们要践踏圣城四十二个月。
11.en: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

11.zh: 我要使我那两个见证人，穿着毛衣，传道一千二百六十天。」
11.en: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

11.zh: 他们就是那两棵橄榄树，两个灯台，立在世界之主面前的。
11.en: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

11.zh: 若有人想要害他们，就有火从他们口中出来，烧灭仇敌。凡想要害他们的都必这样被杀。
11.en: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

11.zh: 这二人有权柄，在他们传道的日子叫天闭塞不下雨；又有权柄叫水变为血，并且能随时随意用各样的灾殃攻击世界。
11.en: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

11.zh: 他们作完见证的时候，那从无底坑里上来的兽必与他们交战，并且得胜，把他们杀了。
11.en: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

11.zh: 他们的尸首就倒在大城里的街上；这城按着灵意叫所多玛，又叫埃及，就是他们的主钉十字架之处。
11.en: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

11.zh: 从各民、各族、各方、各国中，有人观看他们的尸首三天半，又不许把尸首放在坟墓里。
11.en: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

11.zh: 住在地上的人就为他们欢喜快乐，互相馈送礼物，因这两位先知曾叫住在地上的人受痛苦。
11.en: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

11.zh: 过了这三天半，有生气从　神那里进入他们里面，他们就站起来；看见他们的人甚是害怕。
11.en: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

11.zh: 两位先知听见有大声音从天上来，对他们说：「上到这里来。」他们就驾着云上了天，他们的仇敌也看见了。
11.en: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.

11.zh: 正在那时候，地大震动，城就倒塌了十分之一，因地震而死的有七千人；其余的都恐惧，归荣耀给天上的　神。
11.en: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

11.zh: 第二样灾祸过去，第三样灾祸快到了。
11.en: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

11.zh: 第七位天使吹号，天上就有大声音说： 世上的国成了我主和主基督的国； 他要作王，直到永永远远。
11.en: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

11.zh: 在　神面前，坐在自己位上的二十四位长老，就面伏于地，敬拜　神，
11.en: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

11.zh: 说： 昔在、今在的主　神— 全能者啊，我们感谢你！ 因你执掌大权作王了。
11.en: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.

11.zh: 外邦发怒，你的忿怒也临到了； 审判死人的时候也到了。 你的仆人众先知和众圣徒， 凡敬畏你名的人， 连大带小得赏赐的时候也到了。 你败坏那些败坏世界之人的时候也就到了。
11.en: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

11.zh: 当时，　神天上的殿开了，在他殿中现出他的约柜。随后有闪电、声音、雷轰、地震、大雹。
11.en: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.

12.zh: 天上现出大异象来：有一个妇人身披日头，脚踏月亮，头戴十二星的冠冕。
12.en: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

12.zh: 她怀了孕，在生产的艰难中疼痛呼叫。
12.en: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

12.zh: 天上又现出异象来：有一条大红龙，七头十角；七头上戴着七个冠冕。
12.en: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

12.zh: 它的尾巴拖拉着天上星辰的三分之一，摔在地上。龙就站在那将要生产的妇人面前，等她生产之后，要吞吃她的孩子。
12.en: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

12.zh: 妇人生了一个男孩子，是将来要用铁杖辖管万国的；她的孩子被提到　神宝座那里去了。
12.en: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

12.zh: 妇人就逃到旷野，在那里有　神给她预备的地方，使她被养活一千二百六十天。
12.en: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

12.zh: 在天上就有了争战。米迦勒同他的使者与龙争战，龙也同它的使者去争战，
12.en: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

12.zh: 并没有得胜，天上再没有它们的地方。
12.en: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.

12.zh: 大龙就是那古蛇，名叫魔鬼，又叫撒但，是迷惑普天下的。它被摔在地上，它的使者也一同被摔下去。
12.en: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

12.zh: 我听见在天上有大声音说：「我　神的救恩、能力、国度，并他基督的权柄，现在都来到了！因为那在我们　神面前昼夜控告我们弟兄的，已经被摔下去了。
12.en: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

12.zh: 弟兄胜过它，是因羔羊的血和自己所见证的道。他们虽至于死，也不爱惜性命。
12.en: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.

12.zh: 所以，诸天和住在其中的，你们都快乐吧！只是地与海有祸了！因为魔鬼知道自己的时候不多，就气忿忿地下到你们那里去了。」
12.en: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”

12.zh: 龙见自己被摔在地上，就逼迫那生男孩子的妇人。
12.en: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

12.zh: 于是有大鹰的两个翅膀赐给妇人，叫她能飞到旷野，到自己的地方，躲避那蛇；她在那里被养活一载二载半载。
12.en: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

12.zh: 蛇就在妇人身后，从口中吐出水来，像河一样，要将妇人冲去。
12.en: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

12.zh: 地却帮助妇人，开口吞了从龙口吐出来的水。
12.en: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

12.zh: 龙向妇人发怒，去与她其余的儿女争战，这儿女就是那守　神诫命、为耶稣作见证的。
12.en: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.

12.zh: 那时龙就站在海边的沙上。

13.zh: 我又看见一个兽从海中上来，有十角七头，在十角上戴着十个冠冕，七头上有亵渎的名号。
13.en: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.

13.zh: 我所看见的兽，形状像豹，脚像熊的脚，口像狮子的口。那龙将自己的能力、座位，和大权柄都给了它。
13.en: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

13.zh: 我看见兽的七头中，有一个似乎受了死伤，那死伤却医好了。全地的人都希奇跟从那兽，
13.en: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

13.zh: 又拜那龙—因为它将自己的权柄给了兽，也拜兽，说：「谁能比这兽，谁能与它交战呢？」
13.en: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”

13.zh: 又赐给它说夸大亵渎话的口，又有权柄赐给它，可以任意而行四十二个月。
13.en: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

13.zh: 兽就开口向　神说亵渎的话，亵渎　神的名并他的帐幕，以及那些住在天上的。
13.en: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, his dwelling, and those who dwell in heaven.

13.zh: 又任凭它与圣徒争战，并且得胜；也把权柄赐给它，制伏各族、各民、各方、各国。
13.en: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.

13.zh: 凡住在地上、名字从创世以来没有记在被杀之羔羊生命册上的人，都要拜它。
13.en: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.
If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

13.zh: 掳掠人的，必被掳掠； 用刀杀人的，必被刀杀。 圣徒的忍耐和信心就是在此。
13.en: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

13.zh: 我又看见另有一个兽从地中上来，有两角如同羊羔，说话好像龙。
13.en: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.

13.zh: 它在头一个兽面前，施行头一个兽所有的权柄，并且叫地和住在地上的人拜那死伤医好的头一个兽。
13.en: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

13.zh: 又行大奇事，甚至在人面前，叫火从天降在地上。
13.en: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

13.zh: 它因赐给它权柄在兽面前能行奇事，就迷惑住在地上的人，说：「要给那受刀伤还活着的兽作个像。」
13.en: He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast, saying to those who dwell on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.

13.zh: 又有权柄赐给它，叫兽像有生气，并且能说话，又叫所有不拜兽像的人都被杀害。
13.en: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.

13.zh: 它又叫众人，无论大小、贫富、自主的、为奴的，都在右手上或是在额上受一个印记。
13.en: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands or on their foreheads;

13.zh: 除了那受印记、有了兽名或有兽名数目的，都不得做买卖。
13.en: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.

13.zh: 在这里有智慧：凡有聪明的，可以算计兽的数目；因为这是人的数目，它的数目是六百六十六。
13.en: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.

14.zh: 我又观看，见羔羊站在锡安山，同他又有十四万四千人，都有他的名和他父的名写在额上。
14.en: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.

14.zh: 我听见从天上有声音，像众水的声音和大雷的声音，并且我所听见的好像弹琴的所弹的琴声。
14.en: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

14.zh: 他们在宝座前，并在四活物和众长老前唱歌，仿佛是新歌；除了从地上买来的那十四万四千人以外，没有人能学这歌。
14.en: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

14.zh: 这些人未曾沾染妇女，他们原是童身。羔羊无论往哪里去，他们都跟随他。他们是从人间买来的，作初熟的果子归与　神和羔羊。
14.en: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

14.zh: 在他们口中察不出谎言来；他们是没有瑕疵的。
14.en: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.

14.zh: 我又看见另有一位天使飞在空中，有永远的福音要传给住在地上的人，就是各国、各族、各方、各民。
14.en: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

14.zh: 他大声说：「应当敬畏　神，将荣耀归给他！因他施行审判的时候已经到了。应当敬拜那创造天地海和众水泉源的。」
14.en: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”

14.zh: 又有第二位天使接着说：「叫万民喝邪淫、大怒之酒的巴比伦大城倾倒了！倾倒了！」
14.en: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”

14.zh: 又有第三位天使接着他们，大声说：「若有人拜兽和兽像，在额上或在手上受了印记，
14.en: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,

14.zh: 这人也必喝　神大怒的酒；此酒斟在　神忿怒的杯中纯一不杂。他要在圣天使和羔羊面前，在火与硫磺之中受痛苦。
14.en: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.

14.zh: 他受痛苦的烟往上冒，直到永永远远。那些拜兽和兽像，受它名之印记的，昼夜不得安宁。」
14.en: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

14.zh: 圣徒的忍耐就在此；他们是守　神诫命和耶稣真道的。
14.en: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”

14.zh: 我听见从天上有声音说：「你要写下：从今以后，在主里面而死的人有福了！」[圣]灵说：「是的，他们息了自己的劳苦，做工的果效也随着他们。」
14.en: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”

14.zh: 我又观看，见有一片白云，云上坐着一位好像人子，头上戴着金冠冕，手里拿着快镰刀。
14.en: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

14.zh: 又有一位天使从殿中出来，向那坐在云上的大声喊着说：「伸出你的镰刀来收割；因为收割的时候已经到了，地上的庄稼已经熟透了。」
14.en: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”

14.zh: 那坐在云上的，就把镰刀扔在地上，地上的庄稼就被收割了。
14.en: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

14.zh: 又有一位天使从天上的殿中出来，他也拿着快镰刀。
14.en: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

14.zh: 又有一位天使从祭坛中出来，是有权柄管火的，向拿着快镰刀的大声喊着说：「伸出快镰刀来，收取地上葡萄树的果子，因为葡萄熟透了！」
14.en: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”

14.zh: 那天使就把镰刀扔在地上，收取了地上的葡萄，丢在　神忿怒的大酒榨中。
14.en: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.

14.zh: 那酒榨踹在城外，就有血从酒榨里流出来，高到马的嚼环，远有六百里。
14.en: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.

15.zh: 我又看见在天上有异象，大而且奇，就是七位天使掌管末了的七灾，因为　神的大怒在这七灾中发尽了。
15.en: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.

15.zh: 我看见仿佛有玻璃海，其中有火搀杂。又看见那些胜了兽和兽的像并它名字数目的人，都站在玻璃海上，拿着　神的琴，
15.en: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

15.zh: 唱　神仆人摩西的歌和羔羊的歌，说： 主　神—全能者啊， 你的作为大哉！奇哉！ 万世之王啊， 你的道途义哉！诚哉！
15.en: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.

15.zh: 主啊，谁敢不敬畏你， 不将荣耀归与你的名呢？ 因为独有你是圣的。 万民都要来在你面前敬拜， 因你公义的作为已经显出来了。
15.en: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”

15.zh: 此后，我看见在天上那存法柜的殿开了。
15.en: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

15.zh: 那掌管七灾的七位天使从殿中出来，穿着洁白光明的细麻衣，胸间束着金带。
15.en: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.

15.zh: 四活物中有一个把盛满了活到永永远远之　神大怒的七个金碗给了那七位天使。
15.en: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

15.zh: 因　神的荣耀和能力，殿中充满了烟。于是没有人能以进殿，直等到那七位天使[所降]的七灾完毕了。
15.en: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

16.zh: 我听见有大声音从殿中出来，向那七位天使说：「你们去，把盛　神大怒的七碗倒在地上。」
16.en: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”

16.zh: 第一位天使便去，把碗倒在地上，就有恶而且毒的疮生在那些有兽印记、拜兽像的人身上。
16.en: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

16.zh: 第二位天使把碗倒在海里，海就变成血，好像死人的血，海中的活物都死了。
16.en: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.

16.zh: 第三位天使把碗倒在江河与众水的泉源里，水就变成血了。
16.en: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

16.zh: 我听见掌管众水的天使说： 昔在、今在的圣者啊， 你这样判断是公义的；
16.en: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.

16.zh: 他们曾流圣徒与先知的血， 现在你给他们血喝； 这是他们所该受的。
16.en: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”

16.zh: 我又听见祭坛[中有声音]说： 是的，主　神—全能者啊， 你的判断义哉！诚哉！
16.en: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”

16.zh: 第四位天使把碗倒在日头上，叫日头能用火烤人。
16.en: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.

16.zh: 人被大热所烤，就亵渎那有权掌管这些灾的　神之名，并不悔改将荣耀归给　神。
16.en: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.

16.zh: 第五位天使把碗倒在兽的座位上，兽的国就黑暗了。人因疼痛就咬自己的舌头；
16.en: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,

16.zh: 又因所受的疼痛，和生的疮，就亵渎天上的　神，并不悔改所行的。
16.en: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They still didn’t repent of their works.

16.zh: 第六位天使把碗倒在幼发拉底大河上，河水就干了，要给那从日出之地所来的众王预备道路。
16.en: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.

16.zh: 我又看见三个污秽的灵，好像青蛙，从龙口、兽口并假先知的口中出来。
16.en: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;

16.zh: 他们本是鬼魔的灵，施行奇事，出去到普天下众王那里，叫他们在　神全能者的大日聚集争战。
16.en: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God the Almighty.

16.zh: 看哪，我来像贼一样。那警醒、看守衣服、免得赤身而行、叫人见他羞耻的有福了！
16.en: “Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn’t walk naked, and they see his shame.”

16.zh: 那三个鬼魔便叫众王聚集在一处，希伯来话叫作哈米吉多顿。
16.en: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.

16.zh: 第七位天使把碗倒在空中，就有大声音从殿中的宝座上出来，说：「成了！」
16.en: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

16.zh: 又有闪电、声音、雷轰、大地震，自从地上有人以来，没有这样大、这样厉害的地震。
16.en: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.

16.zh: 那大城裂为三段，列国的城也都倒塌了；　神也想起巴比伦大城来，要把那盛自己烈怒的酒杯递给他。
16.en: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

16.zh: 各海岛都逃避了，众山也不见了。
16.en: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

16.zh: 又有大雹子从天落在人身上，每一个约重一他连得。为这雹子的灾极大，人就亵渎　神。
16.en: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague was exceedingly severe.

17.zh: 拿着七碗的七位天使中，有一位前来对我说：「你到这里来，我将坐在众水上的大淫妇所要受的刑罚指给你看。
17.en: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,

17.zh: 地上的君王与她行淫，住在地上的人喝醉了她淫乱的酒。」
17.en: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. Those who dwell on the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”

17.zh: 我被[圣]灵感动，天使带我到旷野去，我就看见一个女人骑在朱红色的兽上；那兽有七头十角，遍体有亵渎的名号。
17.en: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

17.zh: 那女人穿着紫色和朱红色的衣服，用金子、宝石、珍珠为妆饰；手拿金杯，杯中盛满了可憎之物，就是她淫乱的污秽。
17.en: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.

17.zh: 在她额上有名写着说：「奥秘哉！大巴比伦，作世上的淫妇和一切可憎之物的母。」
17.en: And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”

17.zh: 我又看见那女人喝醉了圣徒的血和为耶稣作见证之人的血。 我看见她，就大大地希奇。
17.en: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.

17.zh: 天使对我说：「你为什么希奇呢？我要将这女人和驮着她的那七头十角兽的奥秘告诉你。
17.en: The angel said to me, “Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

17.zh: 你所看见的兽，先前有，如今没有，将要从无底坑里上来，又要归于沉沦。凡住在地上、名字从创世以来没有记在生命册上的，见先前有、如今没有、以后再有的兽，就必希奇。
17.en: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present.

17.zh: 智慧的心在此[可以思想]。那七头就是女人所坐的七座山，
17.en: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.

17.zh: 又是七位王；五位已经倾倒了，一位还在，一位还没有来到；他来的时候，必须暂时存留。
17.en: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, and the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.

17.zh: 那先前有如今没有的兽，就是第八位；他也和那七位同列，并且归于沉沦。
17.en: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.

17.zh: 你所看见的那十角就是十王；他们还没有得国，但他们一时之间要和兽同得权柄，与王一样。
17.en: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.

17.zh: 他们同心合意将自己的能力、权柄给那兽。
17.en: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

17.zh: 他们与羔羊争战，羔羊必胜过他们，因为羔羊是万主之主、万王之王。同着羔羊的，就是蒙召、被选、有忠心的，[也必得胜]。」
17.en: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are called, chosen, and faithful.”

17.zh: 天使又对我说：「你所看见那淫妇坐的众水，就是多民、多人、多国、多方。
17.en: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

17.zh: 你所看见的那十角与兽必恨这淫妇，使她冷落赤身，又要吃她的肉，用火将她烧尽。
17.en: The ten horns which you saw, they and the beast will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her naked, will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.

17.zh: 因为　神使诸王同心合意，遵行他的旨意，把自己的国给那兽，直等到　神的话都应验了。
17.en: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

17.zh: 你所看见的那女人就是管辖地上众王的大城。」
17.en: The woman whom you saw is the great city which reigns over the kings of the earth.”

18.zh: 此后，我看见另有一位有大权柄的天使从天降下，地就因他的荣耀发光。
18.en: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

18.zh: 他大声喊着说： 巴比伦大城倾倒了！倾倒了！ 成了鬼魔的住处 和各样污秽之灵的巢穴， 并各样污秽可憎之雀鸟的巢穴。
18.en: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!

18.zh: 因为列国都被她邪淫大怒的酒倾倒了。 地上的君王与她行淫； 地上的客商因她奢华太过就发了财。
18.en: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”

18.zh: 我又听见从天上有声音说： 我的民哪，你们要从那城出来， 免得与她一同有罪，受她所受的灾殃；
18.en: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,

18.zh: 因她的罪恶滔天； 她的不义，　神已经想起来了。
18.en: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.

18.zh: 她怎样待人，也要怎样待她， 按她所行的加倍地报应她； 用她调酒的杯加倍地调给她[喝]。
18.en: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.

18.zh: 她怎样荣耀自己，怎样奢华， 也当叫她照样痛苦悲哀， 因她心里说： 我坐了皇后的位， 并不是寡妇， 决不至于悲哀。
18.en: However much she glorified herself and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’

18.zh: 所以在一天之内， 她的灾殃要一齐来到， 就是死亡、悲哀、饥荒。 她又要被火烧尽了， 因为审判她的主　神大有能力。
18.en: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire, for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.

18.zh: 地上的君王，素来与她行淫、一同奢华的，看见烧她的烟，就必为她哭泣哀号。
18.en: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,

18.zh: 因怕她的痛苦，就远远地站着说：哀哉！哀哉！ 巴比伦大城，坚固的城啊， 一时之间你的刑罚就来到了。
18.en: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’

18.zh: 地上的客商也都为她哭泣悲哀，因为没有人再买他们的货物了；
18.en: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:

18.zh: 这货物就是金、银、宝石、珍珠、细麻布、紫色料、绸子、朱红色料、各样香木、各样象牙的器皿、各样极宝贵的木头，和铜、铁、汉白玉的器皿，
18.en: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

18.zh: 并肉桂、豆蔻、香料、香膏、乳香、酒、油、细面、麦子、牛、羊、车、马，和奴仆、人口。
18.en: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.

18.zh: [巴比伦]哪，你所贪爱的果子离开了你； 你一切的珍馐美味 和华美的物件也从你中间毁灭， 决不能再见了。
18.en: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

18.zh: 贩卖这些货物、借着她发了财的客商，因怕她的痛苦，就远远地站着哭泣悲哀，说：
18.en: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,

18.zh: 哀哉！哀哉！这大城啊， 素常穿着细麻、 紫色、朱红色的衣服， 又用金子、宝石，和珍珠为妆饰。
18.en: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!

18.zh: 一时之间，这么大的富厚就归于无有了。 凡船主和坐船往各处去的，并众水手，连所有靠海为业的，都远远地站着，
18.en: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,

18.zh: 看见烧她的烟，就喊着说：「有何城能比这大城呢？」
18.en: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’

18.zh: 他们又把尘土撒在头上，哭泣悲哀，喊着说： 哀哉！哀哉！这大城啊。 凡有船在海中的，都因她的珍宝成了富足！ 她在一时之间就成了荒场！
18.en: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.

18.zh: 天哪，众圣徒、众使徒、众先知啊， 你们都要因她欢喜， 因为　神已经在她身上伸了你们的冤。
18.en: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets, for God has judged your judgment on her.”

18.zh: 有一位大力的天使举起一块石头，好像大磨石，扔在海里，说： 巴比伦大城也必这样猛力地被扔下去， 决不能再见了。
18.en: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

18.zh: 弹琴、作乐、吹笛、吹号的声音， 在你中间决不能再听见； 各行手艺人在你中间决不能再遇见； 推磨的声音在你中间决不能再听见；
18.en: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.

18.zh: 灯光在你中间决不能再照耀； 新郎和新妇的声音，在你中间决不能再听见。 你的客商原来是地上的尊贵人； 万国也被你的邪术迷惑了。
18.en: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.

18.zh: 先知和圣徒，并地上一切被杀之人的血，都在这城里看见了。
18.en: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”

19.zh: 此后，我听见好像群众在天上大声说： 哈利路亚！ 救恩、荣耀、权能都属乎我们的　神！
19.en: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;

19.zh: 他的判断是真实公义的； 因他判断了那用淫行败坏世界的大淫妇， 并且向淫妇讨流仆人血的罪， 给他们伸冤。
19.en: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”

19.zh: 又说： 哈利路亚！ 烧淫妇的烟往上冒， 直到永永远远。
19.en: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”

19.zh: 那二十四位长老与四活物就俯伏敬拜坐宝座的　神，说： 阿们！哈利路亚！
19.en: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”

19.zh: 有声音从宝座出来说： 　神的众仆人哪， 凡敬畏他的，无论大小， 都要赞美我们的　神！
19.en: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”

19.zh: 我听见好像群众的声音，众水的声音，大雷的声音，说： 哈利路亚！ 因为主—我们的　神、 全能者作王了。
19.en: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

19.zh: 我们要欢喜快乐， 将荣耀归给他。 因为，羔羊婚娶的时候到了； 新妇也自己预备好了，
19.en: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”

19.zh: 就蒙恩得穿光明洁白的细麻衣。 （这细麻衣就是圣徒所行的义。）
19.en: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

19.zh: 天使吩咐我说：「你要写上：凡被请赴羔羊之婚筵的有福了！」又对我说：「这是　神真实的话。」
19.en: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”

19.zh: 我就俯伏在他脚前要拜他。他说：「千万不可！我和你，并你那些为耶稣作见证的弟兄同是作仆人的，你要敬拜　神。」因为预言中的灵意乃是为耶稣作见证。
19.en: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”

19.zh: 我观看，见天开了。有一匹白马，骑在马上的称为诚信真实，他审判，争战，都按着公义。
19.en: I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

19.zh: 他的眼睛如火焰，他头上戴着许多冠冕；又有写着的名字，除了他自己没有人知道。
19.en: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.

19.zh: 他穿着溅了血的衣服；他的名称为　神之道。
19.en: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”

19.zh: 在天上的众军骑着白马，穿着细麻衣，又白又洁，跟随他。
19.en: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.

19.zh: 有利剑从他口中出来，可以击杀列国。他必用铁杖辖管他们，并要踹全能　神烈怒的酒榨。
19.en: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

19.zh: 在他衣服和大腿上有名写着说：「万王之王，万主之主。」
19.en: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”

19.zh: 我又看见一位天使站在日头中，向天空所飞的鸟大声喊着说：「你们聚集来赴　神的大筵席，
19.en: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,

19.zh: 可以吃君王与将军的肉，壮士与马和骑马者的肉，并一切自主的为奴的，以及大小人民的肉。」
19.en: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”

19.zh: 我看见那兽和地上的君王，并他们的众军都聚集，要与骑[白]马的并他的军兵争战。
19.en: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.

19.zh: 那兽被擒拿；那在兽面前曾行奇事、迷惑受兽印记和拜兽像之人的假先知，也与兽同被擒拿。他们两个就活活地被扔在烧着硫磺的火湖里；
19.en: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

19.zh: 其余的被骑[白]马者口中出来的剑杀了；飞鸟都吃饱了他们的肉。
19.en: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.

20.zh: 我又看见一位天使从天降下，手里拿着无底坑的钥匙和一条大链子。
20.en: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

20.zh: 他捉住那龙，就是古蛇，又叫魔鬼，也叫撒但，把它捆绑一千年，
20.en: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,

20.zh: 扔在无底坑里，将无底坑关闭，用印封上，使它不得再迷惑列国。等到那一千年完了，以后必须暂时释放它。
20.en: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.

20.zh: 我又看见几个宝座，也有坐在上面的，并有审判的权柄赐给他们。我又看见那些因为给耶稣作见证，并为　神之道被斩者的灵魂，和那没有拜过兽与兽像，也没有在额上和手上受过他印记之人的灵魂，他们都复活了，与基督一同作王一千年。
20.en: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

20.zh: 这是头一次的复活。（其余的死人还没有复活，直等那一千年完了。）
20.en: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

20.zh: 在头一次复活有分的有福了，圣洁了！第二次的死在他们身上没有权柄。他们必作　神和基督的祭司，并要与基督一同作王一千年。
20.en: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

20.zh: 那一千年完了，撒但必从监牢里被释放，
20.en: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison

20.zh: 出来要迷惑地上四方的列国，就是歌革和玛各，叫他们聚集争战。他们的人数多如海沙。
20.en: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.

20.zh: 他们上来遍满了全地，围住圣徒的营与蒙爱的城，就有火从天降下，烧灭了他们。
20.en: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.

20.zh: 那迷惑他们的魔鬼被扔在硫磺的火湖里，就是兽和假先知所在的地方。他们必昼夜受痛苦，直到永永远远。
20.en: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

20.zh: 我又看见一个白色的大宝座与坐在上面的；从他面前天地都逃避，再无可见之处了。
20.en: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the sky fled away. There was found no place for them.

20.zh: 我又看见死了的人，无论大小，都站在宝座前。案卷展开了，并且另有一卷展开，就是生命册。死了的人都凭着这些案卷所记载的，照他们所行的受审判。
20.en: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

20.zh: 于是海交出其中的死人；死亡和阴间也交出其中的死人；他们都照各人所行的受审判。
20.en: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.

20.zh: 死亡和阴间也被扔在火湖里；这火湖就是第二次的死。
20.en: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

20.zh: 若有人名字没记在生命册上，他就被扔在火湖里。
20.en: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

21.zh: 我又看见一个新天新地；因为先前的天地已经过去了，海也不再有了。
21.en: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

21.zh: 我又看见圣城新耶路撒冷由　神那里从天而降，预备好了，就如新妇妆饰整齐，等候丈夫。
21.en: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

21.zh: 我听见有大声音从宝座出来说：「看哪，　神的帐幕在人间。他要与人同住，他们要作他的子民。　神要亲自与他们同在，作他们的　神。
21.en: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

21.zh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛，因为以前的事都过去了。」
21.en: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”

21.zh: 坐宝座的说：「看哪，我将一切都更新了！」又说：「你要写上；因这些话是可信的，是真实的。」
21.en: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”

21.zh: 他又对我说：「都成了！我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是初，我是终。我要将生命泉的水白白赐给那口渴的人喝。
21.en: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.

21.zh: 得胜的，必承受这些为业：我要作他的　神，他要作我的儿子。
21.en: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

21.zh: 惟有胆怯的、不信的、可憎的、杀人的、淫乱的、行邪术的、拜偶像的，和一切说谎话的，他们的分就在烧着硫磺的火湖里；这是第二次的死。」
21.en: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”

21.zh: 拿着七个金碗、盛满末后七灾的七位天使中，有一位来对我说：「你到这里来，我要将新妇，就是羔羊的妻，指给你看。」
21.en: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”

21.zh: 我被[圣]灵感动，天使就带我到一座高大的山，将那由　神那里、从天而降的圣城耶路撒冷指示我。
21.en: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

21.zh: 城中有　神的荣耀；城的光辉如同极贵的宝石，好像碧玉，明如水晶。
21.en: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

21.zh: 有高大的墙，有十二个门，门上有十二位天使，门上又写着以色列十二个支派的名字。
21.en: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

21.zh: 东边有三门，北边有三门，南边有三门，西边有三门。
21.en: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.

21.zh: 城墙有十二根基，根基上有羔羊十二使徒的名字。
21.en: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

21.zh: 对我说话的，拿着金苇子当尺，要量那城和城门城墙。
21.en: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.

21.zh: 城是四方的，长宽一样。天使用苇子量那城，共有四千里，长、宽、高都是一样；
21.en: The city is square. Its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, width, and height are equal.

21.zh: 又量了城墙，按着人的尺寸，就是天使的尺寸，共有一百四十四肘。
21.en: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

21.zh: 墙是碧玉造的；城是精金的，如同明净的玻璃。
21.en: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

21.zh: 城墙的根基是用各样宝石修饰的：第一根基是碧玉；第二是蓝宝石；第三是绿玛瑙；第四是绿宝石；
21.en: The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

21.zh: 第五是红玛瑙；第六是红宝石；第七是黄璧玺；第八是水苍玉；第九是红璧玺；第十是翡翠；第十一是紫玛瑙；第十二是紫晶。
21.en: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.

21.zh: 十二个门是十二颗珍珠，每门是一颗珍珠。城内的街道是精金，好像明透的玻璃。
21.en: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

21.zh: 我未见城内有殿，因主　神—全能者和羔羊为城的殿。
21.en: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

21.zh: 那城内又不用日月光照；因有　神的荣耀光照，又有羔羊为城的灯。
21.en: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb.

21.zh: 列国要在城的光里行走；地上的君王必将自己的荣耀归与那城。
21.en: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

21.zh: 城门白昼总不关闭，在那里原没有黑夜。
21.en: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),

21.zh: 人必将列国的荣耀、尊贵归与那城。
21.en: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.

21.zh: 凡不洁净的，并那行可憎与虚谎之事的，总不得进那城；只有名字写在羔羊生命册上的[才得进去]。
21.en: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

22.zh: 天使又指示我在城内街道当中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，从　神和羔羊的宝座流出来。
22.en: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

22.zh: 在河这边与那边有生命树，结十二样果子，每月都结果子；树上的叶子乃为医治万民。
22.en: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

22.zh: 以后再没有咒诅；在城里有　神和羔羊的宝座；他的仆人都要事奉他，
22.en: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.

22.zh: 也要见他的面。他的名字必写在他们的额上。
22.en: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

22.zh: 不再有黑夜；他们也不用灯光、日光，因为主　神要光照他们。他们要作王，直到永永远远。
22.en: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.

22.zh: 天使又对我说：「这些话是真实可信的。主就是众先知被感之灵的　神，差遣他的使者，将那必要快成的事指示他仆人。」
22.en: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”

22.zh: 「看哪，我必快来！凡遵守这书上预言的有福了！」
22.en: “Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”

22.zh: 这些事是我—约翰所听见、所看见的；我既听见、看见了，就在指示我的天使脚前俯伏要拜他。
22.en: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

22.zh: 他对我说：「千万不可！我与你和你的弟兄众先知，并那些守这书上言语的人，同是作仆人的。你要敬拜　神。」
22.en: He said to me, “You must not do that! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”

22.zh: 他又对我说：「不可封了这书上的预言，因为日期近了。
22.en: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.

22.zh: 不义的，叫他仍旧不义；污秽的，叫他仍旧污秽；为义的，叫他仍旧为义；圣洁的，叫他仍旧圣洁。」
22.en: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”

22.zh: 「看哪，我必快来！赏罚在我，要照各人所行的报应他。
22.en: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

22.zh: 我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是首先的，我是末后的；我是初，我是终。」
22.en: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

22.zh: 那些洗净自己衣服的有福了！可得权柄能到生命树那里，也能从门进城。
22.en: Blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.

22.zh: 城外有那些犬类、行邪术的、淫乱的、杀人的、拜偶像的，并一切喜好说谎言、编造虚谎的。
22.en: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

22.zh: 「我—耶稣差遣我的使者为众教会将这些事向你们证明。我是大卫的根，又是他的后裔。我是明亮的晨星。」
22.en: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.”

22.zh: [圣]灵和新妇都说：「来！」听见的人也该说：「来！」口渴的人也当来；愿意的，都可以白白取生命的水[喝]。
22.en: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

22.zh: 我向一切听见这书上预言的作见证，若有人在这预言上加添什么，　神必将写在这书上的灾祸加在他身上；
22.en: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

22.zh: 这书上的预言，若有人删去什么，　神必从这书上所写的生命树和圣城删去他的分。
22.en: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

22.zh: 证明这事的说：「是了，我必快来！」阿们！主耶稣啊，我愿你来！
22.en: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!

22.zh: 愿主耶稣的恩惠[常]与众圣徒同在。阿们！
22.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
